Overview
Winter term: January/February to July 2027
Pepsi, Lay’s, Quaker, Doritos — hungry for more than just great flavors?
Experience what it’s like to shape the future of iconic brands and step into a workplace where culture, creativity, and collaboration drive everything we do.
Every 6 months, PepsiCo BeNeLux welcomes new talent just like you. Our internship program for (near-)graduates offers meaningful projects, mentorship and plenty of opportunities to grow your skills through hands-on experience. It’s not just on-the-job learning, but a chance to develop both personally and professionally.
Join our group of around 30 interns and become part of a community where your voice and perspective matter.
Ready to discover what HR really looks like in practice?
Are you curious about people, business and what happens behind the scenes to make a great organization work? Do you like taking initiative, figuring things out and getting things done?
As our HR Intern Benelux, you’ll become part of the local HR team and get the opportunity to experience HR in practice. Based at our Utrecht HQ, you’ll provide hands-on HR support for our teams in the Netherlands and Belgium, reporting into the People Business Partner responsible for Utrecht HQ.
This isn’t an internship where you’ll spend your time watching from the sidelines. We’re looking for someone who wants to jump in, take ownership and learn by doing.
Responsibilities
WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?
No two days in HR are exactly the same, and what you work on will depend on what’s happening in our business and with our people at that moment.
You could find yourself:
Helping employees and managers with day-to-day HR questions and finding the right answers or solutions
Supporting local HR activities and initiatives across Utrecht and Belgium
Helping coordinate key people processes and activities
Connecting with different HR colleagues and specialists to get things moving
Taking ownership of smaller projects or improvement ideas
Spotting something that could work better and helping us do something about it
Along the way, you may get exposure to different parts of the HR landscape, from People Business Partnering and Talent Management to Learning & Development, Employee Experience or Total Rewards. Exactly what that looks like will depend on the topics and opportunities that come up during your internship.
And because HR rarely stands still, some of the most interesting things you’ll work on might be things we haven’t even thought of yet. We’d love you to be the kind of person who sees an opportunity and says: “I can take that.”
WHAT WILL YOU GET OUT OF IT?
Most importantly, you’ll get the chance to see what working in HR is actually like.
You’ll work alongside an experienced HR team, contribute to real topics and challenges, and interact with employees, managers and different HR teams. We’ll also encourage you to explore different areas when the opportunity comes up, so you can start discovering what part of HR interests you most.
We don’t expect you to know that already. That’s part of the experience.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
A supportive team that will encourage your professional growth and development
An opportunity to be meaningful and impactful within your work and projects
A community of interns - offering additional support, the opportunity to build connections, workshops and much more
Internship compensation of 550€/month and travel reimbursement
Work-from-home toolkit
Qualifications
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
We’re less concerned about you already knowing everything about HR. That’s what an internship is for. What matters more is how you approach things.
You could be a great match if you:
Are currently studying Human Resources, Business Administration, Communication, Psychology, Organizational Studies or a related field
Are curious about people, organizations and business
Are proactive and don’t always wait for someone to tell you what to do
Like to think one step ahead
Are comfortable taking ownership and following things through
Enjoy working with different people and building relationships
Are organized and can keep track of several things at once
Aren’t afraid to ask questions when you don’t know something
Bring energy, ideas and a willingness to learn
Can communicate confidently in English
Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is keen to learn, eager to contribute and not afraid to roll up their sleeves.

Phone screening with one of our recruiters
Interview at our office/online
Offer: You’re hired!

Overview
You’ve learned a lot as a student already. Want to put it into practice at PepsiCo?
Our placement programmes are structured to give you the chance to make an impact on some of the world’s biggest brands. From day one, you’ll be working on projects that matter. You’ll shake things up, shape trends, and get guidance and development to help you discover your potential.
We are looking for enthusiastic undergraduates to join our Supply Chain team on a 12-month placement programme starting in July 2027 on a full time basis.
Everyday millions of people in the UK enjoy our oats, snacks, juices and beverages. As a placement student within Supply Chain, you will have the opportunity to join our 4,500 strong team who are behind these household names. As a function we are spread across 10 sites which include our Quaker Oats Mill in Cupar and our Walkers Crisp factory in Leicester – the largest crisp factory in the world.
Undergraduate placement students have an important part to play in our future and we provide a perfect environment for individuals to develop, whilst feeling valued and having lots of fun. You will have lots of autonomy where your decisions will really make a difference to our business and in return you will have the chance to develop your skills and experience in a fast paced, energetic environment.
Responsibilities
In this placement you will:
Analyse performance data and metric trends, preparing validated data and loss trees to support Daily and Weekly Direction Setting
Facilitate problem-solving sessions and apply structured methodologies, including 6W2H and UPS, to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions
Support the Process Lead in delivering loss elimination activities, including GEMBA walks and equipment and process improvement workstreams, while establishing new operating standards and monitoring their impact on performance
Support continuous improvement projects across equipment and manufacturing processes
Work with line teams to deliver zone physical standard improvements and maintain effective workplace standards
Contribute to SPARK activities by developing centreline parameters, supporting rapid changeovers and completing system health checks
Train, coach and support operators and Front Line Employees in the effective execution of Daily Management Systems
Build practical knowledge of manufacturing processes and Manufacturing Excellence programmes, including SPARK, Integrated Work Systems and Lean Six Sigma
Be given real-life objectives to work on and will be expected to make a noticeable contribution to your department
Qualifications
What are we looking for?
Students that have the full RTW for the duration of the full time placement (July 2026-July 2027)
Students currently in their penultimate year of university studies , where the course includes the option of completing a sandwich placement before returning to study after the placement
Following path to a degree in Mechanical/Electrical, Chemical or Manufacturing Engineering or closely related disciplines
An intellectual curiosity and a willingness to challenge accepted ways of doing things
Passion, for our company, for your development, for sustainability and engineering delivery
Ambition, eagerness to learn and grow your career and aspire to be our future leaders
Creativity, bring your new thinking and fresh ideas to our brands
You! At PepsiCo we bring ourselves to work and embrace diversity and inclusion. We believe our differences is what makes us special
What else do you need to know?
Our placements start in July 2027 on a full-time basis and will last for 12 months, with a salary of £26,600.
Other benefits:
Vibrant culture
Development and mentoring
25 days annual leave plus 8 days bank holidays
Discounted PepsiCo products
Competitive pension scheme
Market-leading health and wellbeing benefits: Virtual GP: available to you and your family 24/7, Discounted gym membership, SWORD; online free digital physiotherapy service
Our application process involves:
Online application
Video Interview sent to you by HR: September- October 2026
Virtual Assesment Center: November – December 2026
Application Closing Date : 30th of October 2026
Our application window is scheduled to close on the above date, however, in the event of a large response we will close applications early. We would therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
About PepsiCo
PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world. PepsiCo generated nearly $92 billion in net revenue in 2024, driven by a complementary beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker, and SodaStream. PepsiCo’s product portfolio includes a wide range of enjoyable foods and beverages, including many iconic brands that generate more than $1 billion each in estimated annual retail sales.
Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to Be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with pep+ (PepsiCo Positive). pep+ is our strategic end-to-end transformation that puts sustainability and human capital at the centre of how we will create value and growth by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for planet and people.

Overview
You’ve learned a lot as a student already. Want to put it into practice at PepsiCo?
Our placement programmes are structured to give you the chance to make an impact on some of the world’s biggest brands. From day one, you’ll be working on projects that matter. You’ll shake things up, shape trends, and get guidance and development to help you discover your potential.
We are looking for enthusiastic undergraduates to join our Supply Chain team on a 12-month placement programme starting in July 2027 on a full time basis.
Everyday millions of people in the UK enjoy our oats, snacks, juices and beverages. As a placement student within Supply Chain, you will have the opportunity to join our 4,500 strong team who are behind these household names. As a function we are spread across 10 sites which include our Quaker Oats Mill in Cupar and our Walkers Crisp factory in Leicester – the largest crisp factory in the world.
Undergraduate placement students have an important part to play in our future and we provide a perfect environment for individuals to develop, whilst feeling valued and having lots of fun. You will have lots of autonomy where your decisions will really make a difference to our business and in return you will have the chance to develop your skills and experience in a fast paced, energetic environment.
Responsibilities
In this placement you will:
Support engineering reliability projects and analysis, helping to improve equipment performance and maintain SAP compliance in collaboration with the ST Group
Develop an understanding of core engineering processes, including SAP, electronic permit-to-work systems, contractor management, and involvement in local projects and works
Maintain weekly KPI metrics and tracking files, prepare monthly reports and graphs, update utility regression data, and communicate performance through site screens and noticeboards
Support Resource Conservation initiatives, including Utility Profiler completion, Annual Operating Plan activities, ReCon projects, training, meetings, campaigns and visual communications
Track ReCon performance, complete Maturity Matrix and Road to Great Performance gap analysis, collate assessment evidence, and maintain action lists and hotlists
Develop communication and engagement plans, recognition initiatives, roadshows, and daily and weekly GEMBA routines and feedback processes.
Support facilities and sustainability projects from initiation through to execution, contributing to resource efficiency, utility optimisation and continuous improvement across the site
Collaborate with teams across the site, external stakeholders and contractors, while building practical engineering knowledge and experience of budgets and financial planning
Be given real-life objectives to work on and will be expected to make a noticeable contribution to your department
Qualifications
What are we looking for?
Students that have the full RTW for the duration of the full time placement (July 2027-July 2028).
Students currently in their penultimate year of university studies , where the course includes the option of completing a sandwich placement before returning to study after the placement.
Following path to a degree in Mechanical/Electrical, Chemical or Manufacturing Engineering or closely related disciplines
An intellectual curiosity and a willingness to challenge accepted ways of doing things
Passion, for our company, for your development, for sustainability and engineering delivery
Ambition, eagerness to learn and grow your career and aspire to be our future leaders
Creativity, bring your new thinking and fresh ideas to our brands
You! At PepsiCo we bring ourselves to work and embrace diversity and inclusion. We believe our differences is what makes us special.
What else do you need to know?
Our placements start in July 2027 on a full-time basis and will last for 12 months, with a salary of £26,600.
Other benefits:
Vibrant culture
Development and mentoring
25 days annual leave plus 8 days bank holidays
Discounted PepsiCo products
Competitive pension scheme
Market-leading health and wellbeing benefits: Virtual GP: available to you and your family 24/7, Discounted gym membership, SWORD; online free digital physiotherapy service
Our application process involves:
Online application
Video Interview sent to you by HR: September- October 2026
Virtual Assesment Center: November – December 2026
Application Closing Date : 30th of October 2026
Our application window is scheduled to close on the above date, however, in the event of a large response we will close applications early. We would therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
About PepsiCo
PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world. PepsiCo generated nearly $92 billion in net revenue in 2024, driven by a complementary beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker, and SodaStream. PepsiCo’s product portfolio includes a wide range of enjoyable foods and beverages, including many iconic brands that generate more than $1 billion each in estimated annual retail sales.
Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to Be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with pep+ (PepsiCo Positive). pep+ is our strategic end-to-end transformation that puts sustainability and human capital at the centre of how we will create value and growth by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for planet and people.
